lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、凛とした姿勢で先生に挨拶してたな
lines.en: Riku, you actually greeted the teacher with this whole dignified-posture thing going on.
lines.style: Teasing mock-impressed attack; quick Kansai bounce, a smirk audible through the whole line.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、部活に尽くされた先輩を尊敬してたな、桜
lines.en: Well you were all respect for that senpai who gave everything to the club, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting mumble that sharpens mid-line; low teen drawl, her name tossed off at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、将棋部で詰将棋の選手権目指してたな
lines.en: And you were seriously gunning for that tsume-shogi championship in shogi club, right?
lines.style: Genuinely curious lean-in; pace quickens, bright rise landing on the championship mention.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣のクラスの凛と話してたな、桜
lines.en: You were talking to Rin from the class next door though, Sakura.
lines.style: Casual counter-jab hiding real interest; flat pitch drop, tiny pause before her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、休み時間に詰将棋解いてたな
lines.en: And you, Riku — sitting there solving tsume-shogi puzzles all through break.
lines.style: Wry closing jab slowed for effect; affectionate eye-roll tone, landing soft, almost fond.
